summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_036 contract. The governance-stage wrapper delegates directly to the runtime adapter, preserves the full consistency-check matrix, projects blocking reasons correctly, and keeps render gating binary: coherent bounded packages pass and critical incoherence blocks rendering.

findings: The implementation accepts the documented packaging, governance, structural, congruence, source and case-isolation inputs, with the wrapper enforcing mapping-shaped input before runtime delegation.

Executable coverage confirms both acceptance and blocking behavior: coherent bounded screening and structural-primary packages pass, while claim-summary drift, output-mode drift, body leakage, chapter-inventory contamination, promoted declared input, unresolved entity conflicts and foreign chart context all block render.

The validator preserves bounded structural and congruence discipline, including invalid-comparison controls, measurement-minimality logic, hardware-escalation checks, finance-to-physics dependency checks and local-binding respect.
The motor stays within boundary: it does not repair packages or invent missing surfaces to make render succeed.
The wrapper returns the expected top-level surfaces: consistency_register, critical_failures, blocking_reason_register, canonical_report_state, critical_failure_count and can_render_pdf.
The read-only governance-wrapper smoke check over the bounded congruence fixture produced consistency_check_count=56, critical_failure_count=0, blocking_reason_count=0 and can_render_pdf=true.

The smoke output preserved the canonical report-state shape and exposed stable leading check ids including executive_thesis_exists, executive_thesis_correctly_inadmissible, executive_thesis_interpretive_fields_complete, executive_thesis_congruence_bridge_complete and dominant_thesis_selection_basis_present.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Executable conformance evidence covered the validator's major check families: report-mode alignment, claim and trace coherence, structural-primary body integrity, congruence boundedness, declared-input downgrade protection, unresolved entity conflicts and case-isolation / chart-context blocking. This is sufficient for conformance review because it exercises both the pass path and the main critical blocking paths of the render gate.
test_results.notes: Ran pytest -q on runtime-orchestrator/tests/test_system_consistency_validator.py, test_system_consistency_validator_congruence.py, test_system_consistency_validator_declared_inputs.py, test_system_consistency_validator_entity_resolution.py and test_system_consistency_validator_case_isolation.py with 41 passing tests and 1 environment warning from urllib3/LibreSSL. Also executed a read-only smoke invocation through artifacts/implementation/codebase/engine.py using the bounded congruence fixture from test_system_consistency_validator_congruence.py and confirmed the wrapper returns the runtime adapter surface unchanged.
